player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''vagabond''') posted a [[Light]] [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You Can Either Profit By This...]] list on DeckTech in December 2001.

notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting;(9)': You Can Either Profit By This..., Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Your Insight Serves You Well, 'Secuirity Volunteers', Scrambled Transmission, An Unusual Amount Of Fear; these count toward the 60.
Posted 'Secuirity Volunteers' matches no card (no Light 'Security ...' effect fits a Heading For The Medical Frigate start), so it is printed as written.

Posted 'tatooine Jabba's Palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'TatooineDB94' dested Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'TatooineMEDB' dested Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay (no Mos Eisley docking bay site other than Docking Bay 94 exists); 'spaceport DB' dested Spaceport Docking Bay; 'Coruscant JCC' dested Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber.

Posted 'Luke/Qui-Gon/Obi-Wan with Stick' dested Luke With Lightsaber / Qui-Gon Jinn With Lightsaber / Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Leia, RP' dested Leia, Rebel Princess; 'Naked Threepio' dested Threepio With His Parts Showing; 'Wookie' dested Wookiee; 'Han with heavy blaster' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol.

Posted 'Blaster Pro/ SATM', 'Bith Shuffle/ DR' and 'Nar Shadaa Chimes/OOS' dested the combo cards Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency, The Bith Shuffle & Desperate Reach and Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes & Out Of Somewhere.

Posted 'Shocking Rev/ Grim' dested Shocking Information & Grimtaash (Shocking Revelation is a Dark card; the strategy says to 'use Grim and pull him with ST', i.e. Scrambled Transmission, which fetches Shocking Information).
Posted 'Nubrein Lieds' dested Nabrun Leids; 'Jedi Prescance' dested Jedi Presence; 'Where you looking for me?' dested Were You Looking For Me?; 'I hope she is alright' dested I Hope She's All Right.
The strategy says the deck won a local tournament in the author's hometown (no event name given).
